name: suspender forward lunge with rear fly
description: A lunge combined with a rear delt fly on suspension straps, working legs, shoulders and upper back together.
instructions: Hold the straps with both hands, leaning back slightly with arms extended.
Step one foot forward into a lunge.
As you lower, pull your arms out wide in a rear fly.
Push through the front foot to return to standing and bring your hands together.
Switch legs on the next rep.
